messages:
Elaine: Quick sync 1: pick final webinar angle for April. I drafted three abstracts, need a pick + speaker pairs.

Mark: send em, locking by EOD so invites go tomorrow. :calendar: 

Elaine: A) "Serving Economics: cut per-token cost w/ batching & cache" - audience: platform PMs.

Elaine: B) "From dev to private: rolling inference into enterprise apps" - audience: infra/enterprise.

Elaine: C) "Benchmarks that matter: honest tradeoffs on latency vs cost" - audience: eng leads evaluating models.

Anika: C for highest lead quality, A for PLG top-of-funnel. Can we promote C as main and A as a follow-up deep-dive?

Jorge: yes. landing page A/B: one emphasizes unit cost, other emphasizes reliability and SLA examples.

Zara: speaker pairings: A -> Sam (DevRel) + Priya (Perf Eng). C -> Research lead Maya + customer Arjun.

Mark: live benchmark is high value but risky. we need a recorded fallback clip and a checklist.

Elaine: rehearsal checklist: bench script in repo, pre-warm infra, fallback clip queued, dashboards up.

Anika: I'll own backstage runbook and handoffs. Jorge, can you add bench script to `marketing/webinars/bench`?

Jorge: adding now. will include exact commands and perf seed so ops can replicate.

Zara: routing: invite high-touch trials (>10k tokens/day) + broad PLG list. tag high-touch with `webinar:bench_deep` -> AE queue.

Elaine: Mark, can growth ops create a lead routing rule mapping hidden form field `tier=trial_high_touch` to AE queue?

Mark: pinging @deploy-bot to create rule `webinar_bench_high_touch`.

deploy-bot: created rule `webinar_bench_high_touch` -> AE queue. ID 77211. verify in CRM.

Anika: proposed rehearsals: tech run Tue 30m, full dress Thu 45m, dry-run Mon of event week 20m. I'll send invites.

Elaine: run-of-show draft: 5m intro, 15m benchmark demo, 10m customer story, 10m Q&A, 5m CTAs. include 1-slide appendix for quantization caveats.

Zara: CTAs: Dedicated eval signup vs private-demo request. we'll test which converts better.

Elaine: decision: lead with abstract C (benchmarks) for main marketing copy, offer A as follow-up. updating copy now. thanks all!
